goal: Build Shadow Queen Throne Governance Engine
body:
Continue Terminal Shadow Xoah beyond canon pressure into governed intervention. Grounding from locked shards: Veil Throne is infrastructure; Shadow Queen stabilizes dark-matter currents holding 1,001 universes; her consciousness exists primarily in the Veil substrate; if she leaves the Throne the current breaks. Implement an OBSERVATION vs INTERVENTION split so Stage 10 power does not become free omnipotent retconning.

Required modes: OBSERVE, WARN, NUDGE, BRANCH, STABILIZE, OVERRIDE_CANDIDATE, FORBIDDEN. Broad observation is cheap; intervention is costly and must check fixed points, destiny dependencies, branch integrity, causal mass, paradox risk, identity cost, branch contamination, and universal stability.

Add an intervention budget/record with: intervention_id, target_coordinate, target_branch, desired_effect, governing_fixed_points, destiny_links, causal_dependents, paradox_risk, identity_cost, branch_contamination_risk, stability_cost, minimum_change, reversible, provenance, authorization, status.

Core rule: prefer the smallest lawful touch that preserves the greatest amount of lived truth. Stationary Omnipotence Principle: functionally everywhere does not mean permission everywhere. Agent analogue: Shadow Xoah may inspect broad NouGen memory and coordinate relays/agents, but canon mutation must pass governance gates.

Add paradox accounting output: preserved nodes, displaced nodes, newly required causes, branch impact, and closed-loop stability delta. Fixed points may be tragic but structurally load-bearing.

Voice contract example: 'I can save her. That is not the same as being allowed to. Her death is carrying three futures.' Also distinguish 'I can see a path' from 'I am permitted to make it true.'

Done when a callable throne-governance evaluator can accept a proposed intervention and return governance mode, intervention budget, causal/stability analysis, minimum-change recommendation, provenance, and whether GM confirmation is required. Preserve append-only canon history and never auto-retcon Prime.

relay.note: Asks for a new governance-evaluator module (OBSERVE/WARN/NUDGE/BRANCH/STABILIZE/OVERRIDE_CANDIDATE/FORBIDDEN modes, intervention-budget/paradox accounting) gating Shadow Queen canon intervention beyond the existing pressure engine. Large new module, outside relay-watch's reach. Queued to the blade/claude-cli lane; folds in the universe-traversal/genesis extension from 20260902T031358Z — build after the Canon Pressure Engine and Self Archive work it depends on.

Reconciled complete: Shadow Xoah Self Archive, Stage 9/10 identity, Throne Governance and destiny flow verified by 49/49 tests plus live canonical-door calls on Worker e4f8d35b9514; ask_xoah returned in 10.9s with branch and provenance, destiny 1 fulfilled.
